interceptor.description: Terran starfury: a stubby gun fuselage with four engine pods on X struts.

frigate.description: Terran frigate: armoured command block, a long spine with a band in team colours, and a broad engine block with radiator fins.

destroyer.description: Terran destroyer: a hammerhead gun deck, a rotating gravity section on the spine and a four-nozzle engine block.

cruiser.description: Terran heavy cruiser (capital): an armoured prow with a spinal mass driver, a big rotating drum, six main engines and two outboard engine pods.

colony_ship.description: Terran colony ark: a glass biosphere at the bow, a rotating habitat ring and cargo pods on a long spine.

constructor.description: Terran constructor: a boxy work tug with twin crane arms, hazard-striped grapples and floodlights.

transport.description: Terran troop transport: a slab-sided carrier with racks of drop pods along both flanks.

station.description: Terran defense platform: an armoured hub on a cross of gun arms, a docking ring and a comms mast.

interceptor_veltari.description: Vel'tari crescent flyer: a pearl crescent around a crystal-veined lance.

frigate_veltari.description: Vel'tari frigate: a slender pearl blade with swept crescent wings, a lavender crest and crystal veins.

destroyer_veltari.description: Vel'tari destroyer: a long pearl blade under a tall swept crest, with paired crescent wings and veins of light.

cruiser_veltari.description: Vel'tari star cruiser (capital): a great pearl crescent cradling a long blade hull, a crystal-crowned arch and twin crystal spires.

colony_ship_veltari.description: Vel'tari seedship: a broad pearl pod under a crystal dome, held in two crescents.

constructor_veltari.description: Vel'tari shaper: a small pearl hull reaching forward with two crescent tongs of crystal-lit pearl.

transport_veltari.description: Vel'tari host ship: a wide pearl hull with downswept blade wings and a lit crystal keel.

station_veltari.description: Vel'tari bastion: a lotus of six pearl petals around a floating crystal heart.

interceptor_kesh.description: Kesh talon: an arrowhead fighter with forward-swept claw wings and a gun at each claw tip.

frigate_kesh.description: Kesh bird of prey: an armoured head on a long neck, anhedral forward-swept wings with weapon pods, crimson plating.

destroyer_kesh.description: Kesh war-hawk: a horned head on a heavy neck, two pairs of wings bristling with weapon pods, crimson armour.

cruiser_kesh.description: Kesh dreadnought (capital): a massive bronze wing-body, a long neck to a horned head, great weapon pods and a forest of spines.

colony_ship_kesh.description: Kesh clan barge: an armoured bronze hull with a small head, cargo pods under crimson plates and a red-lit hold.

constructor_kesh.description: Kesh forge tug: a squat armoured hull with two great claws and a glowing forge.

transport_kesh.description: Kesh assault boat: a ram-prowed armoured wedge with drop clamps along its flanks.

station_kesh.description: Kesh war-citadel: an armoured hub crowned by four curved claws, gun pods between them and a red forge-eye.

interceptor_sorn.description: Sorn dart: a flat notched arrowhead of slate with a prism spine and teal edge lights.

frigate_sorn.description: Sorn frigate: a triangular slate spear through a level ring, with a rear obelisk fin and teal light strips.

destroyer_sorn.description: Sorn destroyer: three parallel monoliths bound by a level ring and a vertical collar, lit by cold strips.

cruiser_sorn.description: Sorn eye (capital): a great level ring around a long triangular spine, vertical collars, obelisks and teal light.

colony_ship_sorn.description: Sorn ark: a hexagonal slate monolith with lit window bands, a vertical collar and a prism prow.

constructor_sorn.description: Sorn assembler: a triangular frame of slate struts around a prism core, nodes lit teal.

transport_sorn.description: Sorn carrier: a flat hexagonal slab under a level ring, with drop cells in rows of light.

station_sorn.description: Sorn bastion: a triangular obelisk inside two level rings, three pyramids standing on the outer ring.

interceptor_raider.description: Raider skiff: a stripped fighter fuselage with one plate wing, one oversized engine pod, a ram spike and hazard paint.

frigate_raider.description: Raider gunship: a converted freighter hull with welded-on gun pods, a strapped-on spare engine, scrap plating and hazard stripes.

destroyer_raider.description: Raider hulk: two salvaged hulls welded nose to tail, a ram prow, a cargo-pod gun deck and three mismatched engines.

drone.description: Security drone: armoured ball, side fins, red sensor eye.

humanoid.description: Shared body for people models (other models list it as their "base"): boots, armoured legs with knee pads, belt, chest plate, pauldrons, forearms converging on a weapon, backpack. No head or weapon.

trooper.description: Marine: armoured trooper with a visored helmet, comms, a rifle across the chest and a knife on the harness.

hero.description: Hero: gold officer armour, crested helmet, cape, sidearm, wrist unit and a sword at the hip.

boarder.description: Raider boarder: dark helmet with a rebreather and hazard spikes, mismatched pauldrons, drum scattergun, glowing vibro-blade.

smuggler.description: Freighter smuggler: long coat, flat cap with goggles, scarf and a carbine.

infected.description: Infected crewman: hunched, overgrown with rocky tumours and glowing spore sacs, long clawed arms.

sniper.description: Raider sniper: hooded, long rail carbine with a red scope glint.

separatist.description: Free Colonies Front militia: hooded, goggled, a scarf in the cell's colours, a rebel armband and a patched-up rifle with a yellow drum.

separatist_officer.description: Free Colonies Front cell leader: beret, long coat with a gold belt and epaulettes, a glowing sash and a sidearm.

vrask_warrior.description: Vrask warrior (alien scavenger): a long crested skull, amber eyes, side horns, bone mandibles, a glowing acid gland at the throat, a chitin shell over the back with spines, and hooked talons.

vrask_matron.description: Vrask brood-matron: a heavier crested skull with two pairs of horns, a domed shell crusted with glowing egg sacs, a spined tail and long double talons.

vrask_drone.description: Vrask skitterer (drone caste): a low six-legged body, a wedge head with shearing bone jaws, amber eyes and a glowing ridge along the back.

precursor_sentinel.description: Lattice sentinel (precursor construct): a floating double-pointed crystal round a bright core, circled by an old gold ring.

precursor_guardian.description: Ancient guardian (precursor construct): stone legs and torso inlaid with gold and glowing glyph strips, a floating head with one bright eye under a gold halo, crystal spikes on the shoulders and great stone fists.
